La Maison de Valebasse

An unbroken line
of interruptions.

The court claims descent from Count Lowvale of the Net, whose name is concealed within the letters of Low Value Content. From the first actual moth to the present generative reign, these are the rulers under whom progressively more content was produced.

01
✦

1947–1969

Moth I, the Debugger

Primus casus verus

An actual moth, elevated posthumously after making a documented physical contribution to debugging.

02
LO

1969–1978

LO I, the Interrupted

Initium interruptum

The first network message attempted LOGIN, delivered LO, and crashed before completing the thought.

03
@

1978–1982

Spam I, the Unsolicited

Electus es cum omnibus

First sovereign to address every subject simultaneously, whether or not correspondence had been requested.

04
:-)

1982–1993

Emoticon I, the Sideways

Verte caput et ride

Established compulsory emotional context and required all subjects to tilt their heads sideways.

05
W

1993–1999

Web I, the Open

Omnibus aperta

Freed information for humanity, which immediately began using it to argue with strangers.

06
00

December 31, 1999–January 1, 2000 · disputed

Y2K, the Almost

Finis mundi dilatus

Disputed pretender to the digital throne. The kingdom survived after years of preparation and several cupboards of bottled water.

07
W

2000–2005

Web I, Restored

Continuatio ordinaria

Restored after the Millennium Interregnum, with most clocks, banks, and household appliances still operational.

08
▶

2005–2007

Content I, the Uploaded

Vita est materia

Declared ordinary existence valuable when recorded, titled, optimized, and uploaded.

09
↓

2007–2016

Scroll I, the Endless

Semper deorsum

A sovereign without bottom, boundary, or natural conclusion.

10
◇

2016–2022

Algorithm I, the Unseen

Ex mandato algorithmi

Neither elected nor understood, yet determined what every subject was permitted to notice.

11
AI

2022–present

Prompt I, the Generative

Multa generata, pauca dicta

Produces infinite answers while accepting no responsibility for the questions.

The succession remains secure

Until the next platform update.
